Done — one execution, passed all checks.

**Approach** (`out/T3/solution.py`): load the flat state dict with `safetensors`, drop the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` mask buffers via an anchored regex, cast only the four enumerated projection suffixes to bfloat16, keep everything else float32, then shard with `huggingface_hub.split_torch_state_dict_into_shards` at a 64 MiB budget and write the index.

**Result**: 148 tensors, 48 bfloat16, 4 shards — `wte.weight` (154 MB) alone in shard 3, the other three shards ≤ 64 MiB of tensor data. Pre-write assertions cover all four required checks; a post-write pass reloads every shard and verifies dtypes and bit-exact values.
